counting_rule: Sum only C01, C02 and C03. Not all campaign attempts, not an exploit success rate, and not distinct vulnerabilities. Earlier overlapping Moodle replays, FPM inclusion variants and worker-pool studies are not added.

cohorts.name: OOM-only multiversion selector
cohorts.basis: Four vulnerable branch members, four fixed comparisons and four inert controls

cohorts.name: Unified installed-Moodle selector
cohorts.basis: Eleven configured runs; selected release/runtime combinations; earlier overlapping runs excluded

cohorts.name: Apache session-file inclusion
cohorts.basis: Eight Apache PHP version cases with three matched controls each; separate application inclusion sink required

mechanisms.name: OOM-only corruption
mechanisms.recorded_outcome: Target-side effects on four vulnerable PHP branch members
mechanisms.limitation: ASLR disabled and image-specific calibration; portable ASLR-on isolated exploitation not established

mechanisms.name: Combined OOM and cross-request stale state
mechanisms.recorded_outcome: Combined-chain target effects and separate no-OOM stale-state/abort observations
mechanisms.limitation: No locally established standalone no-OOM 109619 RCE; same-worker condition is not a mitigation

mechanisms.name: Session serializer mismatch
mechanisms.limitation: Non-default configuration and application prerequisites; no default Moodle or framework exposure claim

mechanisms.name: Application session-file inclusion
mechanisms.recorded_outcome: Eight target effects in selected Apache cohort
mechanisms.limitation: Independent application inclusion sink required; not a bypass of the two core fixes

mechanisms.name: Conditional mid-script decoding
mechanisms.recorded_outcome: Target effect in an assisted application fixture
mechanisms.limitation: Unmodified stock-application object-writing route and exact assignment not established

applications.name: WordPress
applications.outcome: Tested stock REST native-session readback negative
applications.limitation: Separate PHP-core experiments and plugins/custom routes are different claims

applications.name: Moodle
applications.outcome: Conditional handler-switch effects; default/progress-disabled controls negative
applications.limitation: Selected combinations only; no default-installation exposure claim

applications.name: Drupal
applications.outcome: Native progress observed; stock front-controller RCE unproven
applications.limitation: Auxiliary conditional routes are not stock-route proof

applications.name: Symfony
applications.outcome: Conditional handler-switch effect with a custom session-reading route

applications.name: Laravel
applications.outcome: Ordinary database/file session routes did not consume native progress session
applications.limitation: Bounded tested routes, not universal immunity

applications.name: CakePHP
applications.outcome: Conditional handler-switch effect under selected configuration
applications.limitation: Default preset negative; not default-config exposure

applications.name: FrankenPHP
applications.outcome: Startup restart and oracle-assisted later effect
applications.limitation: HTTP-only chain unproven; server/runtime study rather than an application
